_source: The club, 6 and 12 September 2026, by shirt number.
_note:
WHERE THE CLUB SAYS SOMEBODY PLAYS, when the record does not say it clearly. IT NO LONGER WINS OUTRIGHT, and the reason is written in dataset.mjs: this file used to beat every inferred position on the argument that a man being moved cannot be discovered by reading last year's sheets. True of last year's sheets, and not true of this year's. inferPositionsNow reads the latest season with team sheets, and where that season gives a CLEAR answer - at least two starts' worth at one position, and no tie - it is published and this file is not. Six of the entries below are currently overridden that way, and each of them is where the club last said rather than where the man has played in 26/27.

SO THE ENTRIES STAY. A season that is thin or tied is no answer, and then this file is the answer again: Tom Sheehan has one start at left centre back and the club calls him a right back, and Jon Lloyd has been used at six places one apiece. Deleting an entry because a season currently overrides it would blank the man the week he stops playing there.

IT LOSES TO THE PANEL. A position stated on the player's own record wins over this file, so the club correcting somebody in Control panel -> Squad and staff overrides it and this entry can then be deleted. Same rule as every other *-extra.json here: the file is the stopgap and the database is the record.
_replaceWhen: Delete an entry once the same position is set on that player in the control panel. Never delete one because the current season overrides it: the override is per season and this is what the site falls back to.
